bulletproof.efectoHabEN: Protects against bullet, ball, and bomb-based moves.

strong-jaw.descES: Su robusta mandíbula le confiere una mordedura potente.
strong-jaw.descEN: The Pokémon's strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
strong-jaw.efectoHabEN: Strengthens biting moves to 1.5× their power.

refrigerate.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hielo y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
refrigerate.descEN: Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
refrigerate.efectoHabEN: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Ice-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

sweet-veil.descES: No cae dormido y evita también que sus aliados se duerman.
sweet-veil.descEN: Prevents the Pokémon and its allies from falling asleep.

stance-change.descES: Adopta la Forma Filo al lanzar un ataque, o bien la Forma Escudo si usa el movimiento Escudo Real.
stance-change.descEN: The Pokémon changes its form to Blade Forme when it uses an attack move and changes to Shield Forme when it uses King’s Shield.
stance-change.efectoHabEN: Changes Aegislash to Blade Forme before using a damaging move, or Shield Forme before using King’s Shield.

gale-wings.descES: Da prioridad a los movimientos de tipo Volador si sus PS están al máximo.
gale-wings.descEN: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.
gale-wings.efectoHabEN: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.

symbiosis.descES: Pasa su objeto a un aliado que ya haya utilizado el suyo.
symbiosis.descEN: The Pokémon passes its held item to an ally that has used up an item.
symbiosis.efectoHabEN: Passes the bearer's held item to an ally when the ally uses up its item.

mega-launcher.descES: Aumenta la potencia de algunos movimientos de pulsos y auras.
mega-launcher.efectoHabEN: Strengthens aura and pulse moves to 1.5× their power.

grass-pelt.descES: Aumenta su Defensa si hay un campo de hierba en el terreno de combate.
grass-pelt.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.
grass-pelt.efectoHabEN: Boosts Defense while Grassy Terrain is in effect.

pixilate.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Hada y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
pixilate.descEN: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
pixilate.efectoHabEN: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Fairy moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

tough-claws.descES: Aumenta la potencia de los movimientos de contacto.
tough-claws.descEN: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
tough-claws.efectoHabEN: Strengthens moves that make contact to 1.33× their power.

aerilate.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Volador y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
aerilate.descEN: Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
aerilate.efectoHabEN: Turns the bearer's Normal-type moves into Flying-type moves. Moves changed by this ability have 1.3× their power.

gooey.descES: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
gooey.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
gooey.efectoHabEN: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.

fairy-aura.descES: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Hada.
fairy-aura.descEN: Powers up each Pokémon’s Fairy-type moves.
fairy-aura.efectoHabEN: Strengthens Fairy moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

dark-aura.descES: Aumenta la potencia de todos los movimientos de tipo Siniestro.
dark-aura.descEN: Powers up each Pokémon’s Dark-type moves.
dark-aura.efectoHabEN: Strengthens Dark moves for all friendly and opposing Pokémon.

parental-bond.descES: Une fuerzas con su cría y ataca dos veces.
parental-bond.efectoHabEN: Lets the bearer hit twice with damaging moves. The second hit has half power.

aura-break.descES: Invierte los efectos de las auras, por lo que baja la potencia de ciertos movimientos en vez de subirla.
aura-break.descEN: The effects of “Aura” Abilities are reversed to lower the power of affected moves.
aura-break.efectoHabEN: While this Pokémon is on the field, Dark Aura and Fairy Aura weaken moves of their respective types to 2/3 their power, rather than strengthening them.

primordial-sea.descES: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Fuego.
primordial-sea.descEN: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Fire-type attacks.
primordial-sea.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes heavy rain. Heavy rain has all the properties of Rain Dance and also causes damaging Fire moves to fail. Heavy rain ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Desolate Land. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of heavy rain, including allowing Fire moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.

desolate-land.descES: Altera el clima para anular los ataques de tipo Agua.
desolate-land.descEN: The Pokémon changes the weather to nullify Water-type attacks.
desolate-land.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes extremely harsh sunlight. Extremely harsh sunlight has all the properties of Sunny Day and also causes damaging Water moves to fail. Extremely harsh sunlight ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Delta Stream and Primordial Sea. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effects of extremely harsh sunlight, including allowing Water moves to work, but will not allow the weather to be changed.

delta-stream.descES: Altera el clima para anular las vulnerabilidades del tipo Volador.
delta-stream.descEN: The Pokémon changes the weather to eliminate all of the Flying type’s weaknesses.
delta-stream.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle or gains this ability, the weather becomes a mysterious air current. A mysterious air current causes moves to not be super effective against Flying; they do neutral damage instead. Anticipation and Stealth Rock are not affected. The mysterious air current ends when this Pokémon leaves battle or loses this ability, or when this ability is nullified. The weather cannot otherwise be changed except by the effects of Desolate Land and Primordial Sea. Air Lock and Cloud Nine will prevent the effect of a mysterious air current, but will not allow the weather to be changed.

stamina.descES: Aumenta su Defensa al recibir un ataque.
stamina.descEN: Boosts the Defense stat when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
stamina.efectoHabEN: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by one stage when it takes damage from a move.

emergency-exit.descES: Abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad para evitar males mayores.
emergency-exit.descEN: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
emergency-exit.efectoHabEN: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.

wimp-out.descES: Se asusta y abandona el terreno de combate cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad.
wimp-out.descEN: The Pokémon cowardly switches out when its HP becomes half or less.
wimp-out.efectoHabEN: After this Pokémon is hit by a move, if that move caused this Pokémon's HP to drop below half, it switches out.

shields-down.descES: Rompe su coraza cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad y adopta una forma ofensiva.
shields-down.descEN: When its HP drops to half or less, the Pokémon's shell breaks and it becomes aggressive.
shields-down.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle and at the end of each turn, if its HP is 50% or above, it changes into Meteor Form; otherwise, it changes into Core Form. In Meteor Form, it cannot be given a major status ailment (though existing ones are not cured), cannot become drowsy from Yawn, and cannot use Rest (which will simply fail). This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Minior.

water-compaction.descES: Aumenta mucho su Defensa si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Agua.
water-compaction.descEN: Boosts the Defense stat sharply when the Pokémon is hit by a Water-type move.
water-compaction.efectoHabEN: Raises this Pokémon's Defense by two stages when it's hit by a Water move.

stakeout.descES: Si el objetivo de su ataque es sustituido por otro, duplica el daño que infligirá.
stakeout.descEN: Doubles the damage dealt to a target that has just switched into battle.
stakeout.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's moves have double power against Pokémon that switched in this turn.

merciless.descES: Hace que sus movimientos asesten siempre un golpe crítico si el rival está envenenado.
merciless.descEN: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
merciless.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's moves critical hit against poisoned targets.

steelworker.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero.
steelworker.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's Steel moves have 1.5× power.

water-bubble.descES: Reduce el daño que le provocan los movimientos de tipo Fuego y es inmune a las quemaduras.
water-bubble.descEN: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
water-bubble.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon is hit by a Fire move, the damage is halved. When this Pokémon uses a Water move, the power is doubled. This Pokémon cannot be burned, and if it becomes burned, the burn is immediately cured.

berserk.descES: Aumenta su Ataque Especial si sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad debido a algún ataque.
berserk.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat when it takes a hit that causes its HP to drop to half or less.
berserk.efectoHabEN: Whenever this Pokémon takes damage from a move that causes its HP to drop below 50%, its Special Attack rises by one stage.

slush-rush.descES: Aumenta su Velocidad si está granizando.
slush-rush.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.
slush-rush.efectoHabEN: During Hail, this Pokémon has double Speed.

long-reach.descES: Puede usar cualquier movimiento sin entrar en contacto con el rival.
long-reach.descEN: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
long-reach.efectoHabEN: A move used by this Pokémon will not make contact.

liquid-voice.descES: Hace que todos sus movimientos que usan sonido pasen a ser de tipo Agua.
liquid-voice.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon uses a move that is sound-based, that move's type is Water.

galvanize.descES: Convierte los movimientos de tipo Normal en tipo Eléctrico y aumenta ligeramente su potencia.
galvanize.descEN: Normal-type moves become Electric-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
galvanize.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon uses a Normal moves, that move is Electric its power is 1.2×.

triage.descES: Da prioridad a los movimientos que restauran PS.
triage.descEN: Gives priority to the Pokémon's healing moves.
triage.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.

schooling.descES: Forma bancos con sus congéneres cuando tiene muchos PS, lo cual le otorga más fuerza. Cuando le quedan pocos PS, el banco se dispersa.
schooling.descEN: When it has a lot of HP, the Pokémon forms a powerful school. It stops schooling when its HP is low.
schooling.efectoHabEN: If this Pokémon is a Wishiwashi and level 20 or above, then when it enters battle and at the start of each turn, it becomes Schooling Form if its HP is 25% or higher and Solo Form otherwise. This ability cannot be replaced, copied, or nullified.

disguise.descES: Puede eludir un ataque valiéndose de la tela que le cubre el cuerpo una vez por combate.
disguise.descEN: Once per battle, the shroud that covers the Pokémon can protect it from an attack.
disguise.efectoHabEN: If this Pokémon is in its Disguised Form and takes damage from a move, it switches to its Busted Form and the damage is prevented. Other effects are not prevented. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Mimikyu.

power-construct.descES: Cuando sus PS se ven reducidos a la mitad, las células se reagrupan y adopta su Forma Completa.
power-construct.descEN: Other Cells gather to aid when its HP becomes half or less. Then the Pokémon changes its form to Complete Forme.
power-construct.efectoHabEN: Transforms 10% or 50% Zygarde into Complete Forme when its HP is below 50%. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Zygarde.

battle-bond.descES: Al derrotar a un rival, los vínculos con su Entrenador se refuerzan y se convierte en Greninja Ash. Su Shuriken de Agua también se ve potenciado.
battle-bond.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, its bond with its Trainer is strengthened, and its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats are boosted.
battle-bond.efectoHabEN: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent. Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times. This ability cannot be copied or replaced. This ability only takes effect for Greninja.

corrosion.descES: Puede envenenar incluso a rivales de tipo Acero o Veneno.
corrosion.descEN: The Pokémon can poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type.
corrosion.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's moves and item ignore the usual immunity of Poison and Steel Pokémon when attempting to inflict poison.

comatose.descES: No despierta jamás de su profundo letargo e incluso ataca dormido.
comatose.descEN: The Pokémon is always drowsing and will never wake up. It can attack while in its sleeping state.
comatose.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon always acts as though it were Asleep. It cannot be given another status ailment; it's unaffected by Yawn; it can use Sleep Talk; and so on.

queenly-majesty.descES: Intimida al objetivo y le impide usar movimientos con prioridad.
queenly-majesty.descEN: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
queenly-majesty.efectoHabEN: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

innards-out.descES: Al caer debilitado, inflige al rival un daño equivalente a los PS que le quedaran.
innards-out.descEN: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit by the amount equal to its last HP.
innards-out.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon faints from an opponent's move, that opponent takes damage equal to the HP this Pokémon had remaining.

battery.descES: Potencia los ataques especiales de los aliados.
battery.descEN: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
battery.efectoHabEN: Ally Pokémon's moves have their power increased to 1.3×.

dancer.descES: Puede copiar inmediatamente cualquier movimiento de baile que haya usado otro Pokémon presente en el combate.
dancer.descEN: Whenever a dance move is used in battle, the Pokémon will copy the user to immediately perform that dance move itself.
dancer.efectoHabEN: Whenever another Pokémon uses a dance move, this Pokémon will use the same move immediately afterwards.

surge-surfer.descES: Duplica su Velocidad si hay un campo eléctrico en el terreno de combate.
surge-surfer.descEN: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.
surge-surfer.efectoHabEN: Doubles this Pokémon's Speed on Electric Terrain.

fluffy.descES: Reduce a la mitad el daño provocado por los movimientos de contacto, pero duplica el infligido por los de tipo Fuego.
fluffy.descEN: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.
fluffy.efectoHabEN: Damage from contact moves is halved. Damage from Fire moves is doubled.

dazzling.descES: Desconcierta al rival y le impide utilizar movimientos con prioridad en su contra.
dazzling.descEN: The Pokémon dazzles its opponents, making them unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.
dazzling.efectoHabEN: When an opposing Pokémon attempts to use a move that targets this Pokémon or an ally, and that move has priority, it will fail.

soul-heart.descES: Aumenta su Ataque Especial cada vez que un Pokémon cae debilitado.
soul-heart.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat every time another Pokémon faints.
soul-heart.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's Special Attack rises by one stage every time any Pokémon faints.

tangling-hair.descES: Baja la Velocidad del rival cuando este le ataca con un movimiento de contacto.
tangling-hair.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon lowers the attacker's Speed stat.
tangling-hair.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon takes regular damage from a contact move, the attacking Pokémon's Speed lowers by one stage.

beast-boost.descES: Si derrota a un rival en ese turno, aumenta su característica más fuerte.
beast-boost.descEN: The Pokémon boosts its most proficient stat each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
beast-boost.efectoHabEN: Raises this Pokémon's highest stat by one stage when it faints another Pokémon.

power-of-alchemy.descES: Reacciona copiando la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
power-of-alchemy.descEN: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
power-of-alchemy.efectoHabEN: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

rks-system.descES: Cambia su tipo según el disco que lleve instalado.
rks-system.descEN: Changes the Pokémon’s type to match the memory disc it holds.
rks-system.efectoHabEN: Changes this Pokémon's type to match its held Memory. This ability cannot be copied, replaced, or nullified. This ability only takes effect for Silvally.

receiver.descES: Adquiere la habilidad de un aliado debilitado.
receiver.descEN: The Pokémon copies the Ability of a defeated ally.
receiver.efectoHabEN: When an ally faints, this Pokémon gains its Ability.

psychic-surge.descES: Crea un campo psíquico al entrar en combate.
psychic-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
psychic-surge.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Psychic Terrain.

grassy-surge.descES: Crea un campo de hierba al entrar en combate.
grassy-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
grassy-surge.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Grassy Terrain.

electric-surge.descES: Crea un campo eléctrico al entrar en combate.
electric-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
electric-surge.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Electric Terrain.

full-metal-body.descES: Evita que bajen sus características a causa de movimientos o habilidades de otros Pokémon.
full-metal-body.descEN: Prevents other Pokémon’s moves or Abilities from lowering the Pokémon’s stats.
full-metal-body.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or abilities. This effect only applies to normal stat modifications and not more exotic effects such as Topsy-Turvy or Power Swap. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.

misty-surge.descES: Crea un campo de niebla al entrar en combate.
misty-surge.descEN: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle.
misty-surge.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon enters battle, it changes the terrain to Misty Terrain.

shadow-shield.descES: Reduce el daño que sufre si sus PS están al máximo.
shadow-shield.descEN: Reduces the amount of damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.
shadow-shield.efectoHabEN: When this Pokémon has full HP, regular damage (not fixed damage!) from moves is halved. This ability cannot be nullified.

prism-armor.descES: Mitiga el daño que le infligen los movimientos supereficaces.
prism-armor.descEN: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
prism-armor.efectoHabEN: Super-effective damage this Pokémon takes is reduced to 0.75×. This Ability is not bypassed by Mold Breaker, Teravolt, or Turboblaze.

neuroforce.descEN: Powers up moves that are super effective.

intrepid-sword.descES: Aumenta su Ataque al entrar en combate.
intrepid-sword.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
intrepid-sword.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

dauntless-shield.descES: Aumenta su Defensa al entrar en combate.
dauntless-shield.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.
dauntless-shield.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Defense stat the first time the Pokémon enters a battle.

libero.descES: Cambia su tipo al del movimiento que va a usar.
libero.descEN: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.
libero.efectoHabEN: Changes the Pokémon’s type to the type of the move it’s about to use. This works only once each time the Pokémon enters battle.

ball-fetch.descES: Si no lleva equipado ningún objeto, recupera la Poké Ball del primer intento de captura fallido.
ball-fetch.descEN: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.
ball-fetch.efectoHabEN: At any time after the first Poké Ball is thrown and fails to catch a Pokémon, at the end of a turn, if a Pokémon with Ball Fetch is on the field and not holding another item, it will pick up the same type of ball as the first one thrown.

cotton-down.descES: Al ser alcanzado por un ataque, suelta una pelusa de algodón que reduce la Velocidad de todos los demás Pokémon.
cotton-down.descEN: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself.
cotton-down.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stats of all Pokémon except itself.

propeller-tail.descES: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
propeller-tail.descEN: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
propeller-tail.efectoHabEN: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

stalwart.descES: Impide que el rival pueda atraer ataques hacia sí mismo por efecto de su habilidad o sus movimientos.
stalwart.descEN: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.
stalwart.efectoHabEN: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

gulp-missile.descES: Tras usar Surf o Buceo, emerge con una presa en la boca. Al recibir daño, ataca escupiéndola al rival.
gulp-missile.descEN: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.
gulp-missile.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon uses Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

steam-engine.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de tipo Fuego o Agua, le sube muchísimo la Velocidad.
steam-engine.descEN: Boosts the Speed stat drastically when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.
steam-engine.efectoHabEN: Raises the user's Speed by three stages when it is hit by a Fire- or Water-type attack. The attack still deals damage.

mirror-armor.descES: Refleja los efectos que reducen las características.
mirror-armor.descEN: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
mirror-armor.efectoHabEN: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.

punk-rock.descES: Potencia los movimientos que usan sonido y reduce a la mitad el daño que le infligen dichos movimientos.
punk-rock.descEN: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.
punk-rock.efectoHabEN: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

sand-spit.descES: Provoca una tormenta de arena al recibir un ataque.
sand-spit.descEN: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it's hit by an attack.
sand-spit.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon creates a sandstorm when it’s hit by an attack.

ripen.descES: Hace madurar las bayas, por lo que duplica sus efectos.
ripen.descEN: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
ripen.efectoHabEN: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

ice-face.descES: Absorbe el daño de un ataque físico con el hielo de la cabeza, tras lo cual cambia de forma. El hielo se regenerará la próxima vez que granice.
ice-face.descEN: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but the attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it snows.
ice-face.efectoHabEN: When an Eiscue that's in its Ice Face form is hit by a physical move, it takes no damage and changes into its Noice Face form. If a hailstorm or snowstorm begins while Eiscue is in its Noice Face form, or if it is sent out in its Noice Face form during hail, it will immediately revert to its Ice Face form.

ice-scales.descES: Las gélidas escamas que protegen su cuerpo reducen a la mitad el daño que le infligen los ataques especiales.
ice-scales.descEN: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.
ice-scales.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

power-spot.descES: Potencia los movimientos de los Pokémon adyacentes.
power-spot.descEN: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.
power-spot.efectoHabEN: "The power of moves used by the allies of the Pokémon with Power Spot is increased by 30%."

steely-spirit.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Acero de los aliados.
steely-spirit.descEN: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.
steely-spirit.efectoHabEN: Powers up the Steel-type moves of the Pokémon and its allies.

mimicry.descES: Cambia su tipo según el campo que haya en el terreno de combate.
mimicry.descEN: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
mimicry.efectoHabEN: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.

wandering-spirit.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, intercambia su habilidad con la del agresor.
wandering-spirit.descEN: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
wandering-spirit.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

perish-body.descES: Si le alcanza un movimiento de contacto, se debilitará al cabo de 3 turnos, así como su agresor, a menos que abandonen el terreno de combate.
perish-body.descEN: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.
perish-body.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon with Perish Body is hit with a contact move, both the attacker and the Pokémon with Perish Body will faint in three turns.

gorilla-tactics.descES: Potencia su Ataque, pero solo puede usar el primer movimiento escogido.
gorilla-tactics.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.
gorilla-tactics.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

screen-cleaner.descES: Anula los efectos de Pantalla de Luz, Reflejo y Velo Aurora tanto de rivales como de aliados al entrar en combate.
screen-cleaner.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.
screen-cleaner.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon.

neutralizing-gas.descES: Anula los efectos de las habilidades de los demás Pokémon presentes mientras esté en el terreno de combate.
neutralizing-gas.descEN: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.
neutralizing-gas.efectoHabEN: While the Pokémon is in the battle, the effects of all other Pokémon’s Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered.

hunger-switch.descES: Alterna entre su Forma Saciada y Forma Voraz al final de cada turno.
hunger-switch.descEN: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.
hunger-switch.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of every turn.

pastel-veil.descES: Se protege a sí mismo y a sus aliados del envenenamiento.
pastel-veil.descEN: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.
pastel-veil.efectoHabEN: Prevents the Pokémon and its teammates from being poisoned. It also cures teammates of poisoning when it enters the battlefield.

unseen-fist.descES: Si usa un movimiento de contacto, puede infligir daño al objetivo aunque este se proteja.
unseen-fist.descEN: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.
unseen-fist.efectoHabEN: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

quick-draw.descES: A veces, puede atacar el primero.
quick-draw.descEN: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
quick-draw.efectoHabEN: If a Pokémon with this Ability selects a damaging move, it has a 30% chance of going first in its priority bracket.

curious-medicine.descES: Al entrar en combate, rezuma una substancia medicinal por la caracola que revierte los cambios en las características de los aliados.
curious-medicine.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.
curious-medicine.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

chilling-neigh.descES: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho gélido y aumenta su Ataque.
chilling-neigh.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.
chilling-neigh.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

transistor.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Eléctrico.
transistor.efectoHabEN: Increases the power of Electric-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

dragons-maw.descES: Potencia los movimientos de tipo Dragón.
dragons-maw.efectoHabEN: Increases the power of Dragon-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

grim-neigh.descES: Al derrotar a un objetivo, emite un relincho aterrador y aumenta su Ataque Especial.
grim-neigh.descEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.
grim-neigh.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

as-one-spectrier.descES: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Negro de Spectrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-spectrier.descEN: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Spectrier's Grim Neigh Ability.
as-one-spectrier.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon has the combined effects of Unnerve and Grim Neigh. Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry. When this Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

as-one-glastrier.descES: El Pokémon tiene dos habilidades: Relincho Blanco de Glastrier y Nerviosismo de Calyrex.
as-one-glastrier.descEN: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.
as-one-glastrier.efectoHabEN: This Pokémon has the combined effects of Unnerve and Chilling Neigh. Opposing Pokémon cannot eat held Berries while this Pokémon is in battle. Affected Pokémon can still use Bug Bite or Pluck to eat a target's Berry. When this Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

lingering-aroma.descEN: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.
lingering-aroma.efectoHabEN: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Lingering Aroma.

seed-sower.descEN: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.
seed-sower.efectoHabEN: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

thermal-exchange.descEN: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
thermal-exchange.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

well-baked-body.descEN: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.
well-baked-body.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

anger-shell.descEN: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
anger-shell.efectoHabEN: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

purifying-salt.descEN: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
purifying-salt.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon’s pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

guard-dog.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.
guard-dog.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

wind-power.descEN: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
wind-power.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

wind-rider.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.
wind-rider.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

rocky-payload.efectoHabEN: Increases the power of Rock-type moves used by this Pokémon by 50%.

zero-to-hero.descEN: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
zero-to-hero.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.

electromorphosis.descEN: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.
electromorphosis.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

protosynthesis.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
protosynthesis.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

quark-drive.descEN: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.
quark-drive.efectoHabEN: Boosts the Pokémon’s most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

commander.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.
commander.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

good-as-gold.descEN: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.
good-as-gold.efectoHabEN: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon’s status moves.

vessel-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.
vessel-of-ruin.efectoHabEN: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

sword-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.
sword-of-ruin.efectoHabEN: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

beads-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.
beads-of-ruin.efectoHabEN: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

tablets-of-ruin.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.
tablets-of-ruin.efectoHabEN: The power of the Pokémon’s ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

cud-chew.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

opportunist.descEN: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
opportunist.efectoHabEN: If an opponent’s stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

supreme-overlord.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

sharpness.efectoHabEN: Increases the power of all 'slicing' moves by 50%.

costar.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.
costar.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally’s stat changes.

earth-eater.descEN: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

armor-tail.descEN: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

mycelium-might.descEN: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.
mycelium-might.efectoHabEN: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

supersweet-syrup.descEN: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

hospitality.efectoHabEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP.

toxic-chain.descEN: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move
toxic-chain.efectoHabEN: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move.

tera-shift.descEN: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

embody-aspect.descEN: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

tera-shell.descEN: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

poison-puppeteer.descEN: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
